selection_process: Eligible candidates are required to register and appear for the Walk-in Interview.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria from the official advertisement.

Attend the Walk-in Interview on 12th October 2026 at North Eastern Handicrafts and Handlooms Development Corporation Ltd. (NEHHDC), Craft Promotion and Experience Centre (CPEC), Garchuk-Pamohi Road, Guwahati - 781035.
Complete the registration process on 12th October 2026 between 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM.
Bring original testimonials along with one set of self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and other relevant documents.
Submit a detailed resume along with the application during registration.
Persons working under Central/State Govt./Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous bodies must submit a "NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE" at the time of interview from their present employer.
important_instructions: The engagement will be initially for a period of 1 (one) year, extendable based on Corporation requirements and performance. The candidate should not have exceeded the age limit as on 1st July, 2026. Candidates having minimum experience of working under Central/State Govt./Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous will be preferred. No TA/DA will be paid to any candidate for appearing in the interview. Appointment to the post will be subject to being found medically fit as per the prescribed Health Standards. The Management reserves the right to shortlist candidates for further selection/interview based on suitability, or to cancel the recruitment process without assigning any reason. The engaged persons are liable to be transferred to any other location/branch as required by the Corporation.

faq.question: Q1. What is NEHHDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NEHHDC Recruitment 2026 is a walk-in interview recruitment drive conducted by North Eastern Handicrafts and Handlooms Development Corporation Limited for filling 2 contractual supervisor posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NEHHDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, divided between Dyeing and Degumming Supervisor (1 post) and Maintenance Supervisor (1 post).

faq.question: Q3. When is the NEHHDC walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 12th October 2026, with registration taking place from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at North Eastern Handicrafts and Handlooms Development Corporation Ltd. (NEHHDC), Craft Promotion and Experience Centre (CPEC), Garchuk-Pamohi Road, Guwahati - 781035.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Dyeing and Degumming Supervisor?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Textile Technology from a recognized Institution along with a minimum of 5 years of supervisory experience in a textile/dyeing/eri silk spinning mill or manufacturing unit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Maintenance Supervisor?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an ITI from a recognized Institution along with a minimum of 3-4 years of supervisory experience in a textile/dyeing/eri silk spinning mill or manufacturing unit.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for NEHHDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 48 years for Dyeing and Degumming Supervisor and 35 years for Maintenance Supervisor as on 1st July, 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 34,750/- for Dyeing and Degumming Supervisor and Rs. 29,000/- for Maintenance Supervisor.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is initially for a period of 1 (one) year, which may be extended depending upon the requirement of the Corporation and performance.
